info.title: Okta Token Exchange MCP Gateway
info.description: An MCP Gateway that authenticates callers via Okta browser login (`mcp-okta-oauth`), gates tool access by Okta role (`mcp-capability-filter-inbound`), and reaches the downstream `basic-api` MCP server through an Okta On-Behalf-Of / ID-JAG token exchange (`mcp-token-exchange`, `authMode: id-jag`) rather than a shared static credential.

get,post.description: Public entry point for MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP Inspector, ...). Authenticates the caller via Okta browser login, gates the upstream tool(s) behind an Okta role, and forwards the call to the `basic-api` MCP server using a token obtained by exchanging the caller's Okta identity for a downstream-scoped access token (ID-JAG).

tags.name: MCP
tags.description: The MCP Gateway entry point and the Okta-backed auth/token-exchange policies that secure it.
